name: Software Factory
summary: One agent with its own GitHub identity turns issues, failing tests, errors, logs, database anomalies, Slack and customer feedback into tickets, then into reviewed pull requests.

secrets.name: FACTORY_GITHUB_TOKEN
secrets.why: The factory's own GitHub identity (a machine user's token): clone, read and write issues, push kortix/ branches, open pull requests, author every commit.

secrets.name: FACTORY_GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.why: Signs the GitHub webhooks for labeled issues and pull request reviews.

secrets.name: FACTORY_ERRORS_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.why: source-errors: your error tracker's webhook (Authorization: Bearer).

secrets.name: FACTORY_FEEDBACK_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.why: source-customer-feedback-webhook: your feedback form's webhook (Authorization: Bearer).

secrets.name: LINEAR_API_KEY
secrets.why: Ticket store Linear, when the workspace has no Linear connector.

secrets.name: JIRA_API_TOKEN
secrets.why: Ticket store Jira, with JIRA_BASE_URL and JIRA_EMAIL, when the workspace has no Jira connector.

secrets.name: ASANA_ACCESS_TOKEN
secrets.why: Ticket store Asana, when the workspace has no Asana connector.

secrets.name: SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN
secrets.why: source-errors with Sentry: read issues and events (with SENTRY_ORG). Scopes event:read, project:read.

secrets.name: BETTERSTACK_API_TOKEN
secrets.why: source-errors with Better Stack: read error patterns, monitors and incidents. Read-only.

secrets.name: FACTORY_DB_READONLY_URL
secrets.why: source-db-observer: a Postgres role with pg_monitor and default_transaction_read_only. Never a write role.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN
secrets.why: source-db-observer on Supabase (with SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF): advisors, read-only queries, Postgres logs.

secrets.name: CLICKHOUSE_URL
secrets.why: source-logs-anomaly: a read-only ClickHouse or Better Stack Telemetry endpoint for application logs.

secrets.name: PLAIN_API_KEY
secrets.why: source-customer-feedback with Plain: read threads. A read-only API key.

secrets.name: ZENDESK_API_TOKEN
secrets.why: source-customer-feedback with Zendesk (with ZENDESK_SUBDOMAIN and ZENDESK_EMAIL): read tickets.

label: kortix
